args.prompt: Blur and speed lines; the sign flashes on the beat. FAST bombs down a steep city hill on his skateboard, a trail of glowing token glyphs sparking off his wheels; a roadside radar speed sign flashes '2000 TOK/S' above the words 'SLOW DOWN'. Camera: Low angle, FAST rushing toward camera. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, saturated colors, energetic limited animation with smear frames, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
